title: Provider failover between different providers and researcher-driven Antigravity MCP client registration
user_story: As the researcher I keep an agent run going when one subscription hits its quota by continuing on another provider I own, and I can use Antigravity interactively against the same project, without violating any provider's terms.

requirements.description: Ordered pool of different providers (one account each, no duplicates, Antigravity excluded); failover only on errors classified as quota/rate limit; exhausted providers rest for a bounded cooldown shared across runs; all exhausted is unavailable/BLOCKED.
The same agent loop continues on the next provider with the identical conversation, jobs and provenance; evidence from earlier providers remains citable.
Every tool job and provenance record carries the requesting provider/model (actor); chat tool_loop records providers used and flags mixed-model results.
Owner config tools.provider_pool/pool_cooldown_s validated on save (duplicates/Antigravity refused); a malformed saved pool disables failover instead of breaking startup.

Register/unregister PhD Lab in Antigravity's documented MCP config (serverUrl): loopback URL only, other servers preserved, non-empty file backed up, invalid JSON never overwritten, bearer header only when mcp.token is set.

nonfunctional: No account rotation and no driving of Antigravity (its terms)
No new provider credentials; uses existing provider paths
acceptance_criteria: Quota failover continues the same run with attribution
Antigravity registration safe for existing config

scenarios.expected: Duplicates, Antigravity, invalid ids and empty pools refused
Only quota errors fail over; cooldown bounded
Exhausted provider skipped without a call in later runs
Second provider sees full conversation and cites first provider's job
Members routed through existing CLI/local/cloud provider paths (MOCKED calls)
Config refuses account rotation and Antigravity; cooldown bounded
Chat agent mode fails over and attributes job and provenance actor
Merge, preserve, back up, token header, unregister only ours
Invalid JSON untouched; non-loopback URLs refused

recovery: Pool empty by default; unregister Antigravity entry via API; max three repair cycles under TASK-PROVIDER-POOL-661.
test_environment: Provider calls MOCKED (scripted members); agent loop, runtime, registry, sessions/orchestrator and config are real in disposable data; Antigravity config on a temporary path. Real provider quota messages require live runs.

review.method: Same-agent review (not independent): terms constraints (no account rotation, no Antigravity driving), failure classification breadth, startup robustness of saved config, client config preservation.

tdd.scope: RED: same modules on committed 6.6.0 (cf90c98) archive copy without the implementation: 10/10 ERROR. GREEN: dev worktree with implementation: 10/10 PASS. Provider calls MOCKED.
